'''2007 Utah State Championship Chris Harmon LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Harmon]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ob Hyperdrive
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
